page.notes: The first word "decus" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Doubtful readings: "Phænicem" (the ligature may be æ or œ); the Greek word after "veluti" reads as οἰκεῖον, with the accents and the following πρῶτον uncertain. The page number "1" at the foot is small and may be a signature or other mark; it is read here as a page number. Long s is transcribed as s throughout.
